Class Processors

java.lang.Object
org.spongepowered.api.world.generation.structure.jigsaw.Processors
public final class Processors extends Object
Registry IDs of the vanilla structure processors.

Since Minecraft 26.2-snapshot-1, processor kinds are no longer represented by a per-kind object in SpongeAPI — the vanilla registry stores codecs directly. This class holds the stable ResourceKey identifiers of the processors provided by vanilla, suitable for passing to Processor.parse(org.spongepowered.api.registry.RegistryHolder, ResourceKey, org.spongepowered.api.data.persistence.DataView).
